Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id prefixed with 'EFO:'), indication_label (mesh_heading), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary molregno = drug_indication molregno; LEFT JOIN compound_structures molregno = molecule_dictionary molregno. Filter: mesh_heading contains 'leukemia' (case-insensitive); max_phase_for_ind = 4. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
